verdict.rationale: Community reports say H100s are 'pretty easy' to get on Runpod and that 4090s were once widely available, though with later 'low availability' problems. The docs show GPU selection via `--gpu-id`, a large GPU fleet, and a cheaper Community Cloud tier. No first-party evidence names a GPU catalog, H200/B200 availability, or previous-generation datacenter cards. Missing for 10: documented GPU catalog listing H100/H200/B200, evidence of H200/B200 availability, named previous-gen datacenter options with pricing, reliable availability for cheaper tiers.
